items.title: Carrick: We want and need more signings at Man Utd
items.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick says the club "want" and "need" to do more transfer business before the summer window closes on September 1.

items.title: LIV tickets taken off sale, Hatton enters clashing event amid cancellation reports
items.description: Tickets for LIV Golf's season-ending Team Championship event in Michigan are no longer on sale on its official website amid reports it has been cancelled, while star player Tyrrell Hatton has entered a DP World Tour event on the same dates.

items.title: Kelce: Marrying Taylor Swift the best night of my life
'Best night of my life!' | Kelce reveals Taylor Swift wedding details
items.description: Travis Kelce reveals Taylor Swift wedding details ahead of his 14th season with the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.title: Richards to face Kalajdzic showdown on Fisher bill
items.description: British former world title challenger Craig Richards will take on Radivoje Kalajdzic in a 10-round light heavyweight showdown, while Lee Cutler faces Louis Greene in a middleweight clash, on Zuffa Boxing's Johnny Fisher bill at London's Copper Box Arena.

items.title: Rashford, Mainoo & transfers - Carrick calls for more signings
items.description: Before his first full season as Manchester United head coach, Michael Carrick explains why the club need more players, discusses why he is in a privileged position and talks Marcus Rashford and Kobbie Mainoo.

items.title: Celtic sign midfielder Baur on an initial four-year deal
items.description: Celtic have made their fourth summer signing with midfielder Mika Baur joining on an initial four-year deal, with the option for a further year.

items.title: Handling hate and seeking stability - Fofana's Chelsea journey
items.description: Wesley Fofana shed tears, faced criticism for laughing at the wrong moment and exposed racist abuse last season but believes stability will lead to "amazing" Chelsea future.

items.title: Cutler and Greene share intense face-off
items.description: Lee Cutler and Louis Greene had an intense face-off as their fight was announced on Sky Sports News for Zuffa Boxing 11 in September.

items.title: Super League receive investment offer from Australia's National Rugby League
items.description: Super League have received an investment offer from the Australia Rugby League Commission (ARLC) which governs the National Rugby League (NRL) in Australia.

items.title: Fresh talks over Arsenal move for Aston Villa's Konsa
items.description: Aston Villa's central defender Ezri Konsa is thought to be Arsenal's preferred option in their search for a new central defender.
